title: Money deposited not subject to execution, levy, attachment, or lien.
bodyText: All moneys received by the commission pursuant to this part shall not be subject to execution, levy, attachment, or lien of any kind.
bodyHtml: §351-86  Money deposited not subject to execution, levy, attachment, or lien.  All moneys received by the commission pursuant to this part shall not be subject to execution, levy, attachment, or lien of any kind. [L 1986, c 155, pt of §1]
